work.description: The act names da Silva Torres coadjutor of Braga and reviews his conduct at Goa. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF9584-9585 reads: HABITA !N CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE XVII. FEBRVARI!. ANNI. NDCCCLI Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
